Veterans Benefits: West Virginia fully exempts military retired pay from state income tax with no cap. Honorably discharged veterans with a 90% or greater VA disability rating may claim a refundable state income-tax credit equal to timely paid homestead property tax. The state also provides employment preference, education assistance, vehicle tags, and hunting and fishing privileges.

Description: Morgantown is a Monongalia County college city on the Monongahela River, anchored by West Virginia University and WVU Medicine's J.W. Ruby Memorial Hospital. A VA outpatient clinic in adjacent Westover is about a mile from the city centroid, typical home values sit near $274k, and BEA regional prices are below the U.S. average. Coopers Rock and Cheat Lake are a short drive; summers are humid, winters are snowy, and county presidential results remain Republican but have moved 3.4 points Democratic since 2016.
